claims.claim: The complete weighted signed divisor pairing has the exact E/M fibre formula and is positive exactly on occupied shells.
The character sign, parity-energy difference, exact-order embedding, and unscaled degree covariance are exact.
The cross-shell determinant and four-term identity have an exact cyclic boundary obstruction; fusion occurs exactly when nu divides a.
If m=gcd(R,p-1), R divides m^2, and N=R/m>1, the odd residual quotient has an exact complement-colour decomposition with an uncovered-orbit term.
Three is the unique nontrivial odd quotient with universal complement closure, and every larger odd quotient has infinitely many prime-shell uncovered-orbit examples.
Under gcd(R,p-1)=R/3, every third-denominator trace returns at the same shell, with exact word and increasing-triple counts.
The complete applicable residual family is classified from the prescribed prime.
The residual-27 empty locus has exactly two factorization types in the stated prime classes.

nonclaims: No universal Erdős–Straus theorem or counterexample.
No theorem that an applicable third-colour source is nonempty for every hard prime.
No theorem that a cross-shell pair with vanishing boundary obstruction always exists.
No Lean formalization in this tranche.
